front.title: John
front.theme: FROM DUST TO THE WORD MADE FLESH

back.kicker: PART ONE · THE WORD BECAME FLESH
back.hook: The One who made the dust stepped down into it.
paragraphs: Near the end of his Gospel, John tells you why he wrote it: that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.
Twelve weeks walk John 1–5 — the Word before the dust, the Lamb of God, the new birth, living water, and the Son who gives life to the dead.
items: The full passage in the World English Bible
Five Greek word studies, each with a Live It response
Five Life Application practices and a daily prayer
A Bottom Line and a “Lift Up Your Eyes” benediction
